title: Reads are the rounding error
caption: Traffic moved over the 30-day run, three classes against each other. The 6 TB corpus is read once; the serving rollout fans 35 TB to 100 replicas; the checkpoint contract writes ~10.6 PB across 4,320 saves — over 1,000x the epoch read. Storage for this workload is a write system with a read side, not the reverse.

title: The feed requirement is workload-shaped
caption: Median sustained read throughput per emulated H100 accelerator from MLPerf Storage v1.0 closed submissions, by workload: ResNet-50 0.18, CosmoFlow 0.55, 3D U-Net 2.8 GB/s (A100 medians ran about half: 0.09, 0.35, 1.4). The 175B text job needs ~MB/s fleet-wide — the same storage system is overfed on tokens and starved on pixels.
